item.title: Tourism in Mountain Areas: Sustainability, Communities, and Changing Environments
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on tourism in mountain regions, examining the interplay between tourism development, environmental sustainability, local community impacts, and the changing mountain environments. The issue seeks research addressing the challenges and opportunities of managing tourism in mountain areas while balancing conservation, community well-being, and environmental protection.

Appel publié par Journal of Outdoor Recreation and Tourism. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
